put:
  operationId: setUserCustomFieldValue
  x-verification-status: UNCONFIRMED-AGREE
  x-evidence:
    - PROBE-LOG/20260521-060000-put.workspaces.users.custom-field.value-path-probe.json
  x-notes: |
    GET probe on /workspaces/{wId}/users/{userId}/custom-field/{customFieldId}/value
    returned 405 Request method GET is not supported — Spring-MVC 405 means the
    route IS registered in live Clockify (not a 404 No static resource absent path).
    Both specs document PUT at this path. No typed MCP tool targets it:
    clockify_set_custom_field_value (SetCustomFieldValue in custom_fields.go) routes
    project values to PATCH /projects/{pId}/custom-fields/{fieldId} and entry values
    to PUT /time-entries/{entryId} (full entry replacement). The user-scoped path is
    raw-allowlist-only (raw_allowlist_gen.go line 178). Cannot achieve LIVE-VERIFIED
    without raw writes enabled. Classified UNCONFIRMED-AGREE: route present, both
    specs agree, method constraint plausible.
  x-truth-iter: iter22
  parameters:
    - name: workspaceId
      in: path
      required: true
    - name: userId
      in: path
      required: true
    - name: customFieldId
      in: path
      required: true
  requestBody:
    required: true
    content:
      application/json:
        schema:
          type: object
          properties:
            value:
              description: Value to set; type depends on the custom field type
  responses:
    '200':
      description: Updated user custom field value
endpoints.notes: Route is registered in live Clockify (405 on GET probe, not 404 No static resource). Both specs agree. No typed MCP tool uses this path — clockify_set_custom_field_value targets project (PATCH) and entry (PUT) paths only. The workspace-user-scoped custom field value route is raw-allowlist-only (raw_allowlist_gen.go line 178). UNCONFIRMED-AGREE: cannot confirm PUT success without raw writes enabled.

    with full webhook object. Source: webhooks.go line 759 s.Client.Put targeting
    paths.Workspace(wsID, 'webhooks', webhookID). Pre-flight GET fetches existing
    webhook to merge unchanged fields before PUT (full-replacement semantics).
    dry_run:true probe returned current + proposed payload with authToken masked.
    CLAUDE.md notes that clockify_webhooks_test (test-send) has no endpoint; this
    refers to the test-delivery operation only — clockify_webhooks_update (PUT) is

  parameters:
    - name: workspaceId
      in: path
      required: true
    - name: webhookId
      in: path
      required: true
  requestBody:
    required: true
    content:
      application/json:
        schema:
          type: object
          properties:
            name:
              type: string
              minLength: 2
              maxLength: 30
            url:
              type: string
              description: HTTPS callback URL
            webhookEvent:
              type: string
              description: Single Clockify webhook event type e.g. NEW_TIME_ENTRY
            triggerSourceType:
              type: string
              enum: [PROJECT_ID, USER_ID, TAG_ID, TASK_ID, WORKSPACE_ID, ASSIGNMENT_ID, EXPENSE_ID]

              type: array
              items:
                type: string
            authToken:
              type: string
              description: Optional HMAC signing secret; never returned unmasked
  responses:

      description: Updated webhook object
      content:
        application/json:
          schema:
            type: object
            properties:
              id: {type: string}
              name: {type: string}
              url: {type: string}
              webhookEvent: {type: string}
              triggerSourceType: {type: string}
              triggerSource:
                type: array
                items: {type: string}

              deliveryEnabled: {type: boolean}
              planEnabled: {type: boolean}
              userId: {type: string}
              workspaceId: {type: string}

Full-replacement semantics: tool pre-fetches existing webhook and merges unchanged fields. dry_run:true probe also executed successfully.
